messages:
tara: Quick company FYI: we're adjusting a few billing behaviors next month. Please scan this thread and owners note action items. :loudspeaker:

ben: high level?

tara: TL;DR:
- Invoice cutoff moves to 03:00 UTC on the 2nd (was last-day 23:59 UTC).
- Trial/free credits issued after the change will expire after 75 days (was 180). Existing credits are grandfathered.
- Temporary overage buffer: for 30 days post-rollout new Hosted accounts get a 5-day overage buffer where usage above quota is tracked but invoices will not bill until buffer ends. This is to reduce immediate surprise charges from onboarding spikes.

ops-bot: Note: rate limits unchanged. Billing flag: `onboard_overage_buffer_days=5` for accounts created after effective date.

mia: big reduction in credit window, any customer comms draft?

tara: CS will send a customer notice 10 business days ahead. Draft snippet (CS to edit):

```
Subject: Notice: billing timing and trial credit updates
Hi <Customer>,
We will shift our monthly invoice cutoff to 03:00 UTC on the 2nd of each month and new trial credits issued after <DATE> will expire after 75 days. New Hosted accounts created after <DATE> will get a temporary 5-day onboarding overage buffer. Existing credits are not affected.
No action required. Reach support@redwood.example.com with questions.
```

support: CS will review and add FAQ + Console banners for the buffer.

ben: finance implications? will revenue recognition shift?

finance-bot: Revenue recognition unchanged; billing timing shift does not alter service period recognition. Finance will publish a reconciliation note and update forecasting models.

tara: Action owners:
- CS: finalize customer copy & FAQ (owner: support).
- Docs: update billing docs + console banners (owner: mia).
- Billing eng: implement cutoff + buffer flag and e2e test (owner: ben).
- Finance: reconciliation note & forecast update (owner: finance-bot).

ops-bot: Task created: `billing-rollout-2026-12` assigned to ben, mia, support. Reminder scheduled 7 days before rollout.

tara: Thanks everyone. Post any follow-ups in #support or DM me. :thumbsup:
